[LSCO.3.3.1] DS is not Spark, Flink, Kafka Streams, Beam, or Pandas. Its
working memory holds hundreds to thousands of facts, not
millions of records. Its aggregations are over bounded
in-memory backings picked from the catalogue at
[LSER.18.1],
not over historical datasets. Its storage planes (events,
samples, cache) exist for policy support, not for analytics.
